translations.about.title: About us
translations.about.inspiration: This app is inspired by https://quiz.thetasoft.com/ and built as an educational project by two trainees from the Dutch Tax Service, together with two experienced Dutch umpires who work for the Dutch Baseball Association KNBSB.
translations.about.rules: The questions are based on the most recent OBR rules, generic for every country in the world.

translations.about.regards: Best regards, {$LINE_BREAK} Chris, Wytse, Finn and Bram.

translations.home.description: This interactive baseball quiz has hundreds of questions (and growing) on the rules of baseball. It's meant for everybody who wants to practice their knowledge of the rules, like umpires, players and coaches.
translations.home.version: This is only the first basic version of the app. We have many ideas for new features. Probably it contains errors and bugs, too.
translations.home.contact: To get in touch, please {$START_LINK}contact us{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.home.news.title: News
translations.home.news.item3: Links 🔗 (for example to YouTube) can appear in the answers.
translations.home.news.item2: You can select the difficulty level 🤔❓ when starting a quiz.
translations.home.news.item1: You can now report an error (in a question or answers). {$LINE_BREAK}Just click the {$START_ITALIC_TEXT}{$CLOSE_ITALIC_TEXT} icon whenever you see it!
